title: Lupa seviyemi tahmin etti
opener: Talk to me for a minute and I'll guess your English level! What's your favorite movie?
lines: Because the story is amazing and the music is beautiful.
So, what is my English level?
note: This is a short recording. Speak only English, keep each answer to one or two short sentences, warm and natural. No praise, no pronunciation comments. Answer the learner's questions directly.
